blockers.title: On the crew page the update offer and the crew page's floating bar still overlap by 40 px. The bar is now drawn on top, so tapping the centre of 'Aggiorna' hits 'Volontari' (UG2-UX-3 not resolved)
blockers.evidence: UG2-UX-3 (.evidence/UG2/field-ux-review.json) defines the crew page's floating bar as the 'Accesso rapido equipaggi' bar: 'A terra', 'Collocati n/N', 'Volontari' (src/features/crews/CrewManagement.tsx:3593-3595, inside the fixed-height container at :2639). D3 raised only the person-destination panels (:2871, :2986) and the Allievi + button (src/features/students/StudentManagement.tsx:1632) by --update-banner-height. The quick-access bar ignores that height. scripts/check-update-journey.mjs:394 measures 'Destinazione persona selezionata' and records it as crewFloatingBar (:486), so the evidence passes on the wrong element. My test used production builds 0.3.0 (installed, service worker in control) and 0.3.1 (deployed), with the real offer raised through Impostazioni > Cerca aggiornamenti, then Equipaggi with the page at the top. Measured bar vs banner, top to bottom: 412x839 681-739 vs 699-764; 390x844 686-744 vs 704-769; 360x780 622-680 vs 640-705; 320x664 506-564 vs 508-589. At all four sizes, elementFromPoint at the centre of 'Aggiorna' returns the 'Volontari' button, and at the centre of 'Più tardi' it returns the bar's background (or the 'Collocati' counter). WebKit, iPhone 13 at 390x664: bar 506-564 vs banner 524-589, the same result. Playwright's own click on 'Aggiorna' times out because 'Volontari … intercepts pointer events'. Screenshot: only 'N…' and the bottom edges of the two buttons show under the bar.
blockers.reproduction: Production probe in my scratchpad's fieldux-d3/probeP2.ts (+prodcommon.ts; builds made with CVC_APP_VERSION=0.3.0/0.3.1): 1) open 0.3.0, wait until the service worker controls the page, create a D2 course and one student, then Equipaggi > Crea equipaggi; 2) switch the server to 0.3.1; Home > Impostazioni > Cerca aggiornamenti, and the banner appears; 3) tap Equipaggi. Expected: the offer's two buttons are clear of the bar. Observed: a 40 px overlap, and a tap on the centre of Aggiorna scrolls to Volontari. The dev replica (probeF.ts, probeW.ts) gives the same numbers on Chromium and WebKit.
blockers.specRef: 01_PRODUCT_SPEC.md §2 ('The offer covers neither the crew page's floating bar nor the Allievi add button'); 04_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md D3 item 2 ('The banner never covers a floating bar or the add button (UG2-UX-3)'); docs/design/06_DESIGN_RULEBOOK.md R12

blockers.title: In read-only mode, opening 'Modifica allievo' locks the instructor in: Back, the bottom navigation, the phone's Back, 'Fine' and every 'Aggiorna' do nothing
blockers.evidence: exitForm (src/features/students/StudentManagement.tsx:729-746) always calls persistEdit for an existing student, and its leave guard (:749-755) holds the leave. updateStudent always executes an UPDATE, which src/persistence/writeGuard.ts refuses in read-only mode, so persistEdit always fails and the leave never happens. Applying an update goes through the same guard: src/main.tsx calls applyUpdateWhenSafe, which calls requestLeave (src/navigation/browserHistory.ts:63-77), which calls the guard, which calls exitForm(leave). Leave is never called, so the app never reloads into the new version. Production test: a 0.5.0 build writes the course and a 0.3.0 build opens it (notice 'Solo lettura: aggiorna l’app'; Impostazioni shows 0.3.0). Allievi > Mario > Modifica allievo, changing nothing, then the header's 'Indietro da Modifica allievo': the form stays open, and 'Modifiche non salvate. Il testo resta qui.' plus 'Riprova' appear below the fold, so nothing visible changes on screen. Bottom 'Home', 'Equipaggi', the phone's Back and 'Fine' all leave the form open. Dev replica with the real App, banner and applyUpdateWhenSafe, on Chromium and WebKit: the banner's 'Aggiorna' and the notice's 'Aggiorna alla nuova versione' do not reload the page (a reload marker survives) and the form stays open. The same happens when the data turns read-only mid-edit (a newer copy raises the minimum writer while a note is being typed), and also after restoring the note to its saved text. The only way out is to kill the app.
blockers.reproduction: My scratchpad's fieldux-d3/probeP1.ts (production 0.5.0, then 0.3.0, service workers blocked), probeG.ts (read-only from the start, no change made) and probeD.ts (read-only arriving mid-edit), on Chromium Pixel 7 and WebKit iPhone 13. Steps: open read-only data > Allievi > a student > Modifica allievo > tap the back arrow, Home, Fine, phone Back. Expected: back to the profile or list, as in any consultation. Observed: still on the form. Then show the offer and tap Aggiorna. Expected: the app updates (that is the remedy the notice asks for). Observed: no reload, no message.
blockers.specRef: 01_PRODUCT_SPEC.md §2 ('Aggiorna applies it once the current screen has saved or asked about unsaved work'; read-only: 'everything can be consulted … a notice above every screen asks to update the app'); 04_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md D3 success predicate ('applies it without losing unsaved work')

importantFindings.title: With enlarged text the offer fills the screen: 'Nuova versione disponibile' breaks one letter per line, 'Aggiorna' runs off the right edge, and the raised + jumps to the top of the screen or off it
importantFindings.evidence: src/components/UpdateAvailableBanner.tsx:79 puts the text in 'min-w-0 flex-1 [overflow-wrap:anywhere]' beside two shrink-0 buttons. Once the buttons need the whole width, the text gets about 0 px. Banner height measured on Chromium Pixel 7 with the dev replica: 412 px 65; 320 px 81; 320 px at 130% text 287; 412 px at 150% 181; 360 px at 150% 541 of 780; 412 px at 200% 961; 320 px at 200% 1001. Production confirms 320 px at 200%: banner y -487 to 514, and 'Aggiorna' spans x 237-419 in a 320 px viewport, so its centre is off-screen. D3 ties the floating controls to this height. With the + following it: at 360 px and 150% the + sits at y=17, over the first visible student's name; at 320 px and 200% it is at y=-633 (unreachable); at 412 px and 150% it covers the last student card (78 x 73 px overlap at the end of the list). The banner's markup predates D3, but D3 now raises it mid-task at every return to the foreground and makes the controls rise with it.

Raise the offer, open Allievi, set html font-size to 130/150/200% and dispatch a resize, then measure the banner, the + button and the last card. importantFindings.title: When the data turns read-only during work, the failure appears off-screen and the screen's own error loops on 'Riprova'
importantFindings.evidence: The notice is inserted in the page flow at the top (src/App.tsx, ReadOnlyNotice before <main>). In the mid-edit case (probeD.ts) the first refused autosave on the student form shows 'Modifiche non salvate. Il testo resta qui. [Riprova]' while the notice sits at y=-659, off-screen. On the crew page, a move made in read-only mode shows 'Modifica non valida o non salvata. Riprova.' (src/features/crews/CrewManagement.tsx:2434, :2710). In read-only mode 'Riprova' can never succeed, and 'non valida' suggests the instructor did something wrong. Nothing at the point of failure says 'solo lettura' or 'aggiorna'. The brief accepts each screen's existing error, but the existing recovery (Riprova) is a dead end in this state.
importantFindings.reproduction: probeD.ts: Allievi > a student > Modifica allievo > type in Nota del corso; call raiseMinimumWriterUnderOpenApp; type more. Expected: the screen says the course is read-only and how to get out. Observed: a generic 'not saved, retry' error, with the explanation 659 px above the viewport. probeH.ts gives the crew-page message.
importantFindings.specRef: 01_PRODUCT_SPEC.md §2 (read-only notice); docs/design/06_DESIGN_RULEBOOK.md R14 (errore e recupero reali)

qolFindings.title: The read-only notice costs a third to half a screen on every screen, and 1.5 screens at 200% text
qolFindings.evidence: src/components/ReadOnlyNotice.tsx: heading, a three-to-four-line paragraph, a full-width button and a reserved result line. Measured 226 px tall on every screen: 31% of the usable height at 412x839 and 40-52% at 320x664. At 320 px and 200% text it is 740 px, 1.49 to 1.75 times the usable height, before any content. On Home with the one-time 'aggiornata' note as well, the first destination starts at 463 px (412) and 1315 px (320 px at 200%). The state is rare and transient, hence QoL.
qolFindings.reproduction: My scratchpad's fieldux-d3/probeC.ts and probeE.ts; screenshots C-*-chromium-320-200.png.

qolFindings.title: The notice's 'Aggiorna l’app' button runs a search, and with nothing found it says 'Questa è l’ultima versione.' under 'Solo lettura: aggiorna l’app'
qolFindings.evidence: src/components/UpdateCheckButton.tsx: when no update is offered, the label 'Aggiorna l’app' triggers check(), whose 'none' outcome reads 'Questa è l’ultima versione.'. The two lines contradict each other and leave no next step. This happens when the newer data was written by a copy the server does not offer, for example another build on the same origin. Observed text: 'Solo lettura: aggiorna l’app … Aggiorna l’app Questa è l’ultima versione.' The offline and failed outcomes read clearly.
qolFindings.reproduction: probeC.ts with check result 'none'; screenshot C-notice-none-chromium.png.

qolFindings.title: Accepting the update while setting tomorrow's crews lands on today's session at the top, with no confirmation there. The 'aggiornata' note is lost if Home is not visited
qolFindings.evidence: After Aggiorna on Equipaggi with session tue-pm selected and the page scrolled, the reload shows Equipaggi with session sat-pm (the default) and scrollY 0. The 'CVC Helper è aggiornata alla versione …' note shows only on Home. noteInstalledVersion (src/navigation/installedVersion.ts) records the new version at the first render, so after one more restart without visiting Home the note never appears (noteOnHomeAtNextStart 0).
qolFindings.specRef: 01_PRODUCT_SPEC.md §2 ('after an update Home says once which version is now installed')

qolFindings.title: The Allievi + button, raised by the banner, overlaps the last student card at 320 px
qolFindings.evidence: The list's end padding (pb-24 plus the shell's pb-28) does not grow with --update-banner-height. At 320x664 with ordinary text and the offer up, the + (y 435-491) overlaps the last right-hand card (374-444) by 9 px at the end of the list. Without the offer it is clear. qolFindings.title: Focus scroll margin ignores the banner
qolFindings.evidence: src/styles.css:60 reserves only the bottom navigation (5rem) as scroll margin. With the offer up and a short layout viewport, a focused control comes to rest under the banner: 'Telefono' at 342-390 under the banner at 330-395 (412x470); 'Annulla' in the volunteer form at 360x420 and 320x400. Current Chrome and Safari overlay the on-screen keyboard without resizing the layout viewport, so this mainly affects Tab or 'next' focus in short windows.

qolFindings.title: After a wrong tap on 'Più tardi', the way back to the update is three taps, one of them in a top corner
qolFindings.evidence: The offer stays hidden until the next start, as the spec allows. To recover: Home, then the gear at the top right, then 'Aggiorna alla nuova versione' (a primary button right under 'Versione', well away from 'Elimina il corso'). Nothing on Equipaggi or Home hints that an update is waiting.
qolFindings.reproduction: Dev replica: offer > Più tardi > Home > Impostazioni; screenshot P2-settings-offer.png (production).
